           Board Diversity Policy                                                 董事會多元化政策
           In order to enhance the effectiveness of our Board and to              為提高董事會的效率及維持高度企業管治水平，
           maintain the high standard of corporate governance, the                本公司已採納董事會多元化政策，其載列達致
           Company has adopted the board diversity policy which sets              及維持董事會多元化的目的及方法。根據董事
           out the objective and approach to achieve and maintain                 會多元化政策，本公司透過於甄選董事會人選
           diversity of our Board. Pursuant to the board diversity policy,        時考慮多項因素而力求達致董事會多元化，其
           the Company seeks to achieve Board diversity through the               中包括但不限於性別、技能、年齡、專業經驗、
           consideration of a number of factors when selecting the                知識、文化、教育背景、種族及服務年期。最終
           candidates to our Board, including but not limited to gender,          的委任決定將根據有能者居之的原則以及獲選
           skills, age, professional experience, knowledge, cultural,             人員將為董事會帶來的貢獻而決定。
           education background, ethnicity and length of service. The
           ultimate decision of the appointment will be based on merit
           and the contribution which the selected candidates will bring
           to our Board.


           The Directors have a balanced mix of knowledge and skills,             董事具備均衡的知識及技能，包括整體管理及
           including overall management and strategic development,                策略發展、人力資源、資訊科技、會計及財務
           human resources, information technology, accounting and                管理、風險管理、企業管治以及物業及資產評
           financial management, risk management, corporate                       估。董事取得不同專業的學位，包括經濟學、
           governance and evaluation of properties and assets. They               工商管理、土木工程及會計學。董事會的三名
           obtained degrees in various majors including economics,                獨立非執行董事均具有不同的行業背景，人數
           business administration, civil engineering and accounting              佔董事會成員的三分之一以上。此外，董事會

RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL                                      風險管理及內部監控

Risk Management                                                           風險管理
The Board is responsible for the risk management and internal             董事會負責本公司的風險管理及內部監控系統，並檢
control systems of the Company and for reviewing their                    討其有效性。前述系統之設計乃為管理而非消除未能
effectiveness. The aforementioned systems are designed to manage          達成業務目標的風險，僅能合理保證而非絕對保證沒
rather than eliminate the risk of failure to achieve business             有重大失實陳述或損失。
objectives, and can only provide reasonable and not absolute
assurance against material misstatement or loss.


The Company recognizes that risk management is critical to the            本公司深明風險管理對中國的任何房地產開發商的成
success of any property developer in the PRC. Key operational risks       功至關重要。本公司面臨的主要風險包括整體市場條
that the Company face include changes in general market conditions        件的變化、中國房地產市場的監管環境變動、在商業

      The Group is concerned about climate change and is                     本集團關注氣候變化，積極響應發展低碳經濟
      proactively responding to campaigns that aim to develop a              和減少溫室氣體排放的行動。鑒於本集團在房
      low-carbon economy and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.                地產開發業務中產生的溫室氣體排放主要來源
      Since the Group’s greenhouse gas emissions generated from its          於車輛使用所產生的直接排放及外購電力在生
      real estate development business are mainly from the direct            產過程中產生的間接排放，本集團在執行關於
      emissions generated by vehicles as well as the indirect                提高能源效率等措施的同時，進一步在僱員通
      emissions generated by purchased electricity during the                勤的交通選擇以及定期維修車輛等方面作出號
      production process, in implementing measures to enhance                召，如鼓勵員工綠色出行，乘坐公共交通；當
      energy efficiency, the Group calls to action on the                    辦公車輛使用人員作出報修後，維修人員應即
      transportation choices for employees’ commuting and regular            開展維修；對部分車輛實施每5,000公里保養一

      of office vehicles have made a request for vehicle

4.1.2 Remuneration and Benefits                                            4.1.2 薪酬待遇及福利
       The Group keeps endeavoring to set up a remuneration                         本集團持續努力建立既具有市場競爭力又符合
       incentive system that is market-competitive while aligning with              本集團特點的薪酬激勵制度，《弘陽集團有限公
       the Group’s characteristics. Hong Yang Group Company’s                       司薪酬管理制度》中提出僱員薪酬待遇遵循專業
       Remuneration Management System 《弘陽集團有限公司薪酬
                                      (                                             化、差異化與統一化、競爭性與公平性、高薪
       管理制度》) states that employees’ remuneration follows the                       酬、可控性的策略，以固定工資、現金津貼、中
       strategies of professionalism, differentiation and unification,              短期激勵、長期激勵和福利構成全面薪酬激勵
       competitiveness and fairness, high remuneration and                          體系。
       controllability, which constitute a holistic remuneration
       incentive system comprising fixed wages, cash allowance,
       short- and medium-term incentives, long-term incentives and
       benefits.


Professionalism                         Based on the given job output value and competency requirement of each position, the
                                        Group analyzes the job positions to form an echelon system. Meanwhile, the remuneration
                                        levels for external benchmark enterprises are set with reference to corresponding
                                        standardized remuneration for each rank and position, so as to drive the employees to
                                        achieve personal career development and an increase in remuneration.
專業化                                     基於崗位被賦予的工作產出價值與勝任能力的要求，對工作崗位進行分析，形成職
                                        級職位體系；同時，對標外部標桿企業的薪酬水平，制定相應的各職級崗位標準薪
                                        酬，以驅動僱員實現個人職業發展與薪酬增長。
Differentiation and unification         Based on the differences in the nature of positions and regional remuneration levels, the
                                        Group carries out differential management for middle and general positions by lines and
                                        by regions, to further rationalize the increment in salary of cross-regional and cross-line
                                        professionals as a return for their work. For the positions of senior and middle-to-senior
                                        management, unified national remuneration structure and standards are adopted to
                                        support cross-regional talents’ mobility.
差異化與統一化                                 基於崗位性質以及地區薪酬水平差異，針對中層與基層崗位，分條線、分地區進行
                                        薪酬差異化管理，以提高薪酬對於跨區域、條線專業人員的勞動回報合理性；高層
                                        與中高層崗位採取全國統一的薪酬結構和標準，從而支持區域的人才流動。

      ENVIRONMENTAL, SOCIAL AND GOVERNANCE REPORT
      環境、社會及管治報告




      Competitiveness and fairness            Based on the specific needs under the rapid development strategy in the future, the
                                              Group adopts a leading remuneration positioning for core talents. The Group first ensures
                                              its competitiveness on the market can meet the needs for attracting talents, then
                                              enhances its remuneration competitiveness for internal high-potential, high-performance
                                              talents, and gradually achieves internal fairness.
      競爭性與公平性                                 基於未來快速展戰略下的特定需求，針對核心人才採取取領先的薪酬定位，首先確
                                              保外部競爭性滿足吸引人才的需求，然後通過既定時間提升內部高潛質、高績效人
                                              才的薪酬競爭力，並逐步實現內部公平性。
      High remuneration                       The overall remuneration structure offers high basic salary, generous performance-based
                                              incentives and basic benefits. Through high basic salary, employees’ basic livelihood is
                                              enhanced and secured; through structured and generous bonus mechanism, incentives for
                                              high-calibre and high-performance employees are enhanced; through basic benefits, the
                                              Company’s care for its employees is manifested.
      高薪酬                                     薪酬總結構上採取高固定、高浮動、基礎福利的薪酬給付組合。通過高固定薪酬，
                                              提高僱員的基本生障水平和安全感；通過結構化、高浮動的獎金機制，提高對高能
                                              力、高績效僱員的激勵力度；通過基礎福利，體現企業對僱員的關懷。
      Controllability                         Based on real estate development company’s implementation of remuneration cost, the
                                              Group adopts management and control over the total cost of remuneration and benefits,
                                              with the aim of achieving a balance between business growth and increment of
                                              employees’ income by enhancing the controllability of remuneration in the overall
                                              operating cost.
      可控性                                     基於房地產開發公司薪酬成本的實踐，針對薪酬福利成本採取總額管控，提高薪酬
                                              在整體運營成本的可管控度，以達到企業業成長與僱員收益增長之間的平衡。

The Development Milestone of Hong Yang Geeks’ Walk：

弘陽極客行的發展歷程：



2014                           In the first Hong Yang Geeks’ Walk campaign, thousands of geeks from Nanjing, Suzhou,
                               Changzhou, Wuxi, Nantong and Changshu spread the walking culture of “daring to fight,
                               daring to rise up to challenges” to employees, property owners, the media, partners and
                               sports lovers by participating in a 24-hour relay walk race.

2014年                          在第一季弘陽極客行活動中，來自南京、蘇州、常州、無錫、南通、常熟六城的千名極
                               客通過24小時接力行走，向僱員、業主、媒體、夥伴、運動愛好者傳遞勇於拼搏，敢於
                               挑戰的徒步文化。




2015                           The Geeks’ Walk campaign has gradually become one of the most influential cultural branding
                               activities of Hong Yang Group. In 2015, participants of the second Geeks’ Walk extended to
                               cover the families of property owners, creating a walking aura of “walking for health, walking
                               for bliss”.

2015年                          極客行活動逐漸成為弘陽集團最有影響力的文化品牌活動之一。在2015年第二季極客酷
                               彩行中，參與人群開始向業主家庭延伸，形成「為健康行走，為快樂行走」的徒步氛圍。

       2016                  The third Geeks’ Walk grasped the opportunity brought by the 20th anniversary of Hong Yang

May 2018         On May 28, 2018, Hong Yang Group put forward the charitable strategy “Ten School in Ten
                 Provinces, Hundred Books for Hundred Villages”. The Group will invest RMB200 million in the
                 field of teaching assistance in the next ten years to alleviate poverty through targeted
                 measures. “Hong Yang Charitable Fund” was also set up to help children get out of the
                 mountainous regions and actualize their self-worth with the power of knowledge.

2018年5月          2018年5月28日，弘陽集團提出「十省十校百村百圖」的公益戰略，計劃未來十年，將投
                 入兩億元人民幣在助學支教領域開展精準扶貧，成立「弘陽公益基金」，以知識的力量幫
                 助孩子們走出大山，實現自我價值。




September 2018   In this year’s “Geeks’ Expeditionary Campaign”, Hong Yang’s expeditionary team consisting of
                 more than 140 senior management faced up to the diverse landscapes such as the Danxia
                 landform of Zhangye, canyons, grasslands, Gobi and beaches and completed 80 km walking
                 challenge in three days. Meanwhile, together with the media, property owners, merchants and
                 charitable volunteers, the Group visited three primary schools in Sunan Yugur Autonomous
                 County, Gansu, to assist local education bureau to preserve schools by establishing traditional
                 Yugur characteristics, helping to preserve intangible cultural heritage.

2018年9月          在本年度「極客遠徵行動」中，由140餘名高管組成的弘陽極客遠徵軍直面張掖丹霞、峽
                 谷、草原、戈壁、沙灘等多樣化地貌，完成了三天80公里徒步挑戰；同時攜手媒體、業
                 主、商戶、公益志願者走進甘肅張掖肅南裕固族自治縣的3所小學，協助當地教育局建

      Provision for land appreciation tax                                        土地增值稅撥備


       The Group is a comprehensive property developer in Mainland China         We involved internal tax specialists to assist us to perform a review on
       focusing on the development of residential properties and the             the LAT position, including the review of the estimates and
       development, operation and management of commercial and mixed-            assumptions used by the Group and the evaluation of tax exposure
       use properties. Land appreciation tax (“LAT”) in Mainland China is one    based on communications received from the relevant tax authorities
       of the main components of the Group’s taxation charge. LAT is levied      and applying our local knowledge and experience. We also
       on the sale of properties at progressive rates ranging from 30% to 60%    recalculated the tax computation and compared our calculations with

       period, the Group estimates the provision for land appreciation tax       吾等已委聘內部稅務專家協助吾等對土地增值稅狀況進行審查，
       based on its understanding and interpretation of the relevant tax rules   包括審查貴集團使用的估計及假設，以及根據相關稅務部門發出
       and regulations, and the estimated total sales of properties less total   的通訊資料及應用本地知識及經驗評估稅務風險。吾等亦已重新
       deductible expenditure, which includes prepaid land lease payments,       計算稅項計算結果，並將吾等的計算結果與貴集團錄得的金額進
       property development costs and borrowing costs. When the LAT is           行比較。
       subsequently determined, the actual payments may be different from
       the estimates.
       貴集團為一家中國內地的綜合性房地產開發商，專注於開發住宅
       物業，以及開發、運營及管理商業及綜合用途物業。中國內地的
       土地增值稅（「土地增值稅」）為貴集團稅項支出的主要組成部分之
       一。物業銷售的土地增值稅乃按照30%至60%的累進稅率對土地增
       值額徵收。於各報告期末，貴集團管理層會根據其對相關稅務規
       則及法規的理解及詮釋對土地增值稅撥備及估計物業銷售總額減
       可扣減開支總額（包括土地使用權租賃開支、物業開發成本、借款
       成本及開發支出）作出估計。在隨後確定土地增值稅時，實際付款
       金額可能與估計值有所不同。


       The accounting policies and disclosures for the provision for land
       appreciation tax are included in notes 3 and 10 to the consolidated
       financial statements.
       有關土地增值稅撥備的會計政策及披露載於綜合財務報表附註3及
       10。

   The Group recognises an allowance for ECLs for all debt                 本集團確認對並非按公允價值計入損益的所有
   instruments not held at fair value through profit or loss. ECLs         債務工具預期信貸虧損的撥備。預期信貸虧損
   are based on the difference between the contractual cash                乃基於根據合約到期的合約現金流量與本集團
   flows due in accordance with the contract and all the cash              預期收取的所有現金流量之間的差額而釐定，
   flows that the Group expects to receive, discounted at an               並以原實際利率的近似值貼現。預期現金流量
   approximation of the original effective interest rate. The              將包括出售所持抵押的現金流量或組成合約條
   expected cash flows will include cash flows from the sale of            款的其他信貸提升措施。
   collateral held or other credit enhancements that are integral
   to the contractual terms.


   General approach                                                        一般方法
   ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for             預期信貸虧損分兩個階段進行確認。就自初步
   which there has not been a significant increase in credit risk          確認起未有顯著增加的信貸風險而言，預期信
   since initial recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses that     貸虧損提供予由未來十二個月內可能發生違約
   result from default events that are possible within the next 12         事件而導致的信貸虧損（十二個月預期信貸損
   months (a 12-month ECL). For those credit exposures for                 失）。就自初步確認起經已顯著增加的信貸風險
   which there has been a significant increase in credit risk since        而言，不論何時發生違約，於餘下風險年期內

   settle the obligation, provided that a reliable estimate can be
